book.name: 1 PETER
book.title: Id ash d Peter Wehpeg Oꞌohana

content: Mat has wo chum masmak g uꞌuwi
Ahpim uꞌuwi amt ab wo e dagitokch heheꞌejel e‑kuhkun ha wui k ch s‑ap wo ha nuhkudad chum hems hegam mo pi ab hu wohochud g Jiosh. Tp hems ab wo i s‑wohoch
am neidch g s‑ap haꞌichu hab em‑juni, chum ams hems pi has wo kaijjid ab amjed g e‑wohochudadag.

S‑ap amt ulinim d wo uꞌuwik ch wabshaba heg pi ab hu wo hiwgad mams ab wo si has masma e apꞌech. Pi at wo em‑apꞌech am Jiosh tahgio mamt has masma wo apꞌech g e‑moꞌo o an hab wo juh g si s‑namkig aꞌanilo ch sisishpakud ch eniga.
Baꞌich i mamt wo s‑hemajimak ch wo s‑dodolimak. T hab wo s‑apꞌek g em‑doakag am Jiosh tahgio.
Bo wa masma hab chuꞌig g Jiosh wohochuddam uꞌuwi ga hu i wehpeg ch ab i e dagitokch heheꞌejel e‑kuhkun ha wui.

Sarabad o wa hab chuꞌig ch ab s‑wohog elid g Abrahambad mo heg d ha‑wanimeddam am ha‑kihdag ed. Kumt ahpim Jiosh wohochuddam uꞌuwi am hab wo junihid g s‑apꞌekam ch pi haꞌichukaj wo e kudutad. T heg wo wa wepok mam d Sarabad amjedkam.
Mat has wo chum masmak g chechoj

Ahpim chechoj amt ab wo has ha elidad g e‑hohonig nam pi s‑mahch mo pi am hu hugkam s‑gewkdag mam ahpim. Bamt masma s‑ap wo e hoꞌigeꞌidahunad g e‑hohonig ha wehm. T g Jiosh ab wo em‑kaihamad. Am g wo s‑chegitok mam e wehm uꞌukch g pi ha huhugedam doakag no pi g Jiosh ab em‑mahkch.
Matt s‑ap wo nako g shoꞌigdag
Wehsijj amt ab wo i e hemakochud k ab aꞌai wo si i e tatchuad ch wo s‑e hoꞌigeꞌidad ch ab wo i e shoꞌigch aꞌai e wui.
Pi g am wo e agwua g pi apꞌekamkaj k pi ab hu wo i nodagi g pi kehg neꞌoki. Ab o t‑ab matt ab wabsh wo i s‑ha hoꞌigeꞌel. T g Jiosh ab epai wo i s‑t‑hoꞌigeꞌel nat pi heg hekaj ab i t‑wai.
An o hab chuꞌig Jiosh heki hu oꞌohana ed:

content.text: Pi g am wo pad neneokad ch pi haꞌichu wo ha iattogidad mamtp wo tatchuad mamt s‑ap e tahtk ch in d wo dodakamk ch wo s‑hehgigk.
Hemho wa amt wo s‑ohhod g pi apꞌekam k am hab wo junihid g s‑apꞌekam ch am wo i e nako mamt wo s‑ap e tahtkkad ab wehs ha wui.
T g Jiosh wo em‑nuhkudad ch ab wo kaihamad g em‑hoꞌigeꞌidahuna.
Mtp wabshaba hab wo junihid g pi apꞌekam, t g Jiosh ab em‑wui wo kehkkad. Psalm 34:12-16

content: Neh, bo wa masma an oꞌohadag.
K pi hab chum mahs mas hedai wo s‑koꞌokam em‑juh mamt am wo si e nakogad mamt am hab wo junihid g s‑apꞌekam.
Tp hab wo mahsk mamt wo e shoꞌigch am hab junihidch g s‑apꞌekam, mt wabsh wo s‑ap e tahtkkad nat pi g Jiosh ab wo wa s‑em‑hoꞌigeꞌel heg hekaj. Pi g wo shaꞌi ha ehbidad hegam mat wo em‑shoꞌigchudad.
Ab g wo has elidad g t‑kownalig Jesus Christ ch chum hekid wo e nahtokchid mamt s‑ap wo ahgi mat hedai ab wo i em‑kakke mam haschu wui ab e gewpkadch.
Kumt wabsh si s‑ap e taht k wabsh s‑hemajim ab wo ha ahgi. Haꞌi atp hems pi ap has wo em‑ahg k ab wo chum em‑abch g pi apꞌekam k wabshaba wo si e el mamtp chum hekid am hab wo junihid g s‑apꞌekam.
S‑apꞌe o matt wo t‑shoꞌigch am hab junihidch g s‑apꞌekam matp d wo Jiosh tatchuik. K wabshaba d si edadag mattp am hab wo junihid g pi apꞌekam ch hekaj wo t‑shoꞌigch.

Jesus Christ o d hekia s‑apꞌekam ch wa eda e shoꞌigch. Pegih, tt ahchim hab waꞌap wo t‑shoꞌigch. E at muhkid g Jesus Christ am t‑wehhejed ahchim mach d pi ap chuꞌijkam mat am wo i t‑ui Jiosh wui. Chuhkugaj amt hi wa chum mua. T wabshaba g Hekia S‑apꞌekam Gewkdag baꞌich i mah g gewkdag.
Id gahi wuhshanim Hekia S‑apꞌekam Gewkdag o wa g Jesus Christ am ha mihshmad hegam mo hemu d koꞌi ch gam hu si kuhpi.

Jiosh ash wa si s‑hemajim ab ha nenida g hemajkam mash eda g Noahbad ab s‑wohog elid ch nahtohim g geꞌe wahlko. Tsh wabshaba g hemajkam pi ab hu wohog el. Tsh hab ha wiꞌin. Tsh hegam waꞌi Noahbad e doꞌibia am i wahpk wahlko ch ed matsh am i ha wiꞌin. Sh d gigiꞌik hemajkam matsh e doꞌibia.

Id ani wepogid g t‑pahl wakonadag. Heg att hekaj am t‑chehgi mach s‑wohochud mat g Jesus Christ s‑ap gahi wuhsh g muhkig am t‑wehhejed. Tt ahchim hab waꞌap s‑ap wo gahi wuwha. Pi o hab d ahga g pahl wakonadag machs wabsh wako g t‑chuhkug. Bo d ahga matt ab i t‑dagito Jiosh wui nat pi gam hu hab i juh g pi ap t‑chuꞌijig. Ch hahawa pi heg hekaj t‑kudut.
Christ at gam hu hih dahm kahchim wui. Kush g Jiosh ab si has elid an e‑hugid an dahshch e‑kownal daikud an. Kush g anghil ch nahnko mahs gewpkdag an dahm kahchim ch ed ab wecho.
